# Mola UI

> A design system cut like a mola: flat layers, hard keylines, revealed bands. React components for dense internal tools and AI-native interfaces. Published as `@demogar/mola-ui`: React 19, Base UI for behaviour, Tailwind v4 for styling, design tokens as CSS custom properties.

65 components and 14 AI components (79 documented pages).

Install and set up:

```bash
npm install @demogar/mola-ui @base-ui/react @fontsource-variable/archivo @fontsource-variable/alegreya @fontsource-variable/martian-mono
```

`@base-ui/react` is a peer dependency: install it beside the package so the app and Mola share one copy. The package is ESM only; `require()` works on Node 22.12 or later.

```tsx
import '@fontsource-variable/archivo/wdth.css'
import '@fontsource-variable/alegreya/wght.css'
import '@fontsource-variable/martian-mono/wdth.css'
import '@demogar/mola-ui/styles.css'
import { Button } from '@demogar/mola-ui'
```

Mount the providers once, at the app root (in Next.js, `app/layout.tsx`):

```tsx
import { DirectionProvider, ToastProvider, TooltipProvider } from '@demogar/mola-ui'

<DirectionProvider direction="ltr">
  <ToastProvider>
    <TooltipProvider>
      <App />
    </TooltipProvider>
  </ToastProvider>
</DirectionProvider>
```

`ToastProvider` is required: `useToast()` throws without it. `DirectionProvider` gives Base UI the keyboard direction; for right-to-left, set `dir="rtl"` on `<html>` and `direction="rtl"` on the provider. `TooltipProvider` is optional.

Theme and density are attributes, not props: `<html data-theme="dark" data-density="compact">`. Leave `data-theme` off to follow the OS; a stored choice is set by an inline `<head>` script before the first paint. `styles.css` includes Tailwind's preflight and styles `body`; in an existing app, import `@demogar/mola-ui/components.css` instead, which scopes the reset to the components. Already on Tailwind v4? Import `@demogar/mola-ui/tailwind.css` into your own build instead of `styles.css`.

## Rules

- Interactive edges use `shadow-cut` (`shadow-floating` on popups, `shadow-overlay` on dialogs and drawers), never `border`. `border-keyline` is for decorative dividers only. Every other edge is a named utility (`rule-b`, `cut-t`, `bar-start-ink`, `cut-anil`, `focus-ring`), never an arbitrary `shadow-[…]` or an `rtl:` twin. A box-shadow edge can grow a revealed band on hover without moving its neighbours; the named edges flip for right-to-left by themselves and keep an edge in forced-colours mode.
- Radius is zero. `rounded-full` only for something that is genuinely a dot. The system is cut cloth: nothing in it is rounded.
- State is never colour alone: glyph, word and colour, in that order of importance. It has to survive colour blindness, a greyscale screenshot and forced colours.
- Disabled is stated, not faded. No `opacity-*` on a disabled control; a disabled control of your own stands on `bg-disabled` with `text-ink-muted` and keeps its keyline. Opacity fades the keyline and the label to about 2:1, a failure axe does not report because disabled controls are exempt.
- Colours come from tokens, each through a utility its scope allows (surface `bg-`, text `text-`, edge `border-`/`decoration-`, mark `bg-`/`fill-`). No hex, rgb or arbitrary colour values outside `tokens.css`. Every token pairing has a measured contrast ratio in both themes; a colour outside the token file, or a token outside its scope (`text-cloth-pale` compiles), was never measured.
- Theme and density are attributes (`data-theme`, `data-density`) on `<html>` or a subtree, not props or React context. Dialogs and menus portal to `<body>` and must inherit them. No component takes a density prop.
- Lay out with logical properties: `ps-`/`pe-`, `ms-`/`me-`, `inset-s-`/`inset-e-`, `text-start`/`text-end`. `dir="rtl"` then mirrors the layout with no second set of classes.
- Typefaces have roles: Archivo (`font-ui`) for the interface, Alegreya (`font-text`) for prose from a person or a model, Martian Mono (`literal`) only for machine literals. A reader can tell from the letterforms whether the product, a person or the machine is speaking.
- Labels are sentence case; buttons start with a verb and name the object (“Cancel run”, not “OK”). A button that names its consequence can be chosen without reading the surrounding text.
- Unknown duration is the relleno working state, never a spinner; elapsed time counts up instead of a progress bar inventing a percentage. Model work has no knowable total, and a bar that stalls at 90% is a lie.
- Anything that writes to the world waits for a person, with the choices given equal weight (`ToolCall` approval, `ChangeReview`). An agent’s action is only as safe as the decision in front of it.
- Use the components for behaviour. Do not re-implement focus trapping, roving focus or typeahead; the components are built on Base UI. A maintained primitive gets keyboard and screen-reader behaviour right in more cases than a local copy.
- Check a component’s lifecycle phase before building on it. Stable is covered by semver, Experimental may change in a minor release, and Deprecated names its replacement: use that instead. A screen built on a component that is about to change or go is built twice.
- Do what each component’s accessibility section leaves to you, usually an accessible name or a label. The component handles roles, focus and announcements. Axe catches a missing name only on the screens it is run on; the component cannot know what its button is for.
- On a product screen, rojo means danger and is used only through the danger role (`bg-danger`, `bg-danger-soft`, `text-ink-danger`, `band-danger`). The accent is gold, by name (`band-accent`). A red label band or bullet beside a red FAILED mark makes the failure one red thing among several (ADR 0008).
- A screen reflows at 320px: only a region meant to scroll sideways (a table, code, a tab or chip row) may, and it carries the `scroll-edge` utility with `useScrollEdge()` as its ref. Table, Tabs and CodeBlock already do. WCAG 1.4.10 is measured at 320px, and a region that scrolls with no cue reads as complete: a table hid its Status column and its only action that way.
- Props share one vocabulary: `tone` is a status (`neutral`, `info`, `success`, `warn`, `danger`, `accent`), `variant` a presentation (`solid`, `outline`, `seam`), `kind` a category (`EmptyState kind="no-results"`), and `size` the t-shirt scale (`xs` to `xl`). A word that means one thing on every component can be guessed instead of looked up, by a person or an agent.
- Every component takes `ref`, `id`, `data-*` and the other DOM props of the element it documents. `className` and `style` style the box you see (the element with the cut); `ref` and the rest go to the control you focus. A wrapper around a label has `wrapperClassName`. A `className` that moved to another element when a `label` was added changed meaning silently.

## Lifecycle phases

Every component has one phase. Stable unless the index says otherwise.

- Experimental: Its API may change in a minor release, without a deprecation first.
- Stable: Semantic versioning applies: nothing breaks without a deprecation first.
- Deprecated: It still works and warns in development. It will be removed; move to its replacement.

## Docs

- [Choosing a component](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/mola-ui-choosing-a-component--overview): which component for which job, and what to use instead
- [Getting started](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/mola-ui-getting-started--overview): install, the app root and its providers, existing apps, theme switching without a flash, density, right-to-left, Tailwind, Next.js
- [Principles](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/mola-ui-principles--overview): the six rules every component obeys
- [AI interface principles](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-principles--overview): streaming, latency, approval, uncertainty, failure
- [Decisions](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/decisions-all-decisions--overview): the architecture decision records behind colour roles, themes, density and typography
- [Versioning](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/mola-ui-versioning--overview): lifecycle phases, what counts as breaking, deprecation, codemods
- [Known gaps](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/mola-ui-known-gaps--overview): open limitations, and what has not been tested by hand
- [Component manifest](https://github.com/demogar/molaui/blob/main/docs/ai/components.json): every export, prop, variant and story as JSON

## Files for agents

Read the one you need rather than all of them. Every docs page also has a Markdown version: `?path=/docs/<id>` is `https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/<id>.md`, linked as "Markdown" below.

- [Components](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/llms-components.txt): every component's usage, props, accessibility, anatomy and where it is used
- [Tokens](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/llms-tokens.txt): every design token with its role and its value in the light and the dark theme; each colour's scopes and the only utilities valid for it; every promised contrast pairing
- [Patterns](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/llms-patterns.txt): whole screens, what each is built from, and its states
- [Rules](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/llms-rules.txt): the design rules alone, numbered as `check_code` cites them, with the lifecycle phases
- [Full text](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/llms-full.txt): all of the above except the tokens, in one file

An MCP server with the same data ships in the package: `npx -y --package @demogar/mola-ui mola-ui-mcp`. Its tools are `list_components`, `get_component` (with `brief: true` for the summary, usage and props alone), `search`, `get_tokens`, `get_rules`, `get_pattern` and `check_code`, which reviews code you wrote against the design rules and returns each finding with its line, rule and fix.

## Actions

- [Button](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-actions-button--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-actions-button--overview.md)): A cut-shape button for an action on this page, with IconButton for an action shown as an icon alone.

## Data display

- [Avatar](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-data-display-avatar--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-data-display-avatar--overview.md)): A person or an agent as a square tile, with initials or a glyph on a colour picked from the name.
- [Code](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-data-display-code--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-data-display-code--overview.md)): Machine text: Code for an inline literal, CodeBlock for a labelled block with copy and wrap.
- [Description list](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-data-display-description-list--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-data-display-description-list--overview.md)): Term and value pairs: the properties of a run, a document or an evaluation.
- [Relative time](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-data-display-relative-time--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-data-display-relative-time--overview.md)) (Experimental): A moment as its distance from now, “3 minutes ago” or “in 2 days”, in a time element that keeps the exact moment.
- [Stat](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-data-display-stat--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-data-display-stat--overview.md)): A KPI tile: a label, a figure, a change with its direction and sentiment, and an optional sparkline.
- [Swatch](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-data-display-swatch--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-data-display-swatch--overview.md)): A small decorative colour key, square or round, in one of the badge tones, placed before the word it keys.
- [Table](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-data-display-table--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-data-display-table--overview.md)): Table primitives for rows of records, and DataTable for columns as data with sorting, selection, column visibility, pages, virtual rows, resizing, expansion and a frozen first column.
- [Timeline](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-data-display-timeline--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-data-display-timeline--overview.md)): Timeline for events already written down, on a spine; StepList for ordered steps a person follows.

## Feedback

- [Badge](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-feedback-badge--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-badge--overview.md)): A small status mark in one of the system’s tones; StatusDot for a square dot beside a label; RecommendationBadge for an editorial scale.
- [Banner](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-feedback-banner--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-banner--overview.md)) (Experimental): A strip across the top of the application for a condition of the whole app, for as long as it holds.
- [Callout](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-feedback-callout--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-callout--overview.md)): A message that belongs to a region of the page, with a tone, an optional title and actions.
- [Empty state](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-feedback-empty-state--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-empty-state--overview.md)): What a panel shows when it has nothing to show, in four variants: empty, no results, error and no permission.
- [Notification centre](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-feedback-notification-centre--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-notification-centre--overview.md)) (Experimental): The record of what happened: a bell with an unread count, and the notifications under it, kept after their toasts have gone.
- [Placeholder](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-feedback-placeholder--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-placeholder--overview.md)): A slot for something that does not exist yet, such as a chart with no data, announced as one image.
- [Progress](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-feedback-progress--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-progress--overview.md)): Progress for work moving toward done, which may be indeterminate; Meter for a reading inside a known range, with thresholds.
- [Skeleton](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-feedback-skeleton--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-skeleton--overview.md)): Bones in the shape of content that has not arrived, with SkeletonGroup to mark the region busy and say once what is loading.
- [Toast](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-feedback-toast--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-toast--overview.md)): A floating notice for something that happened elsewhere or just now; a running toast turns into its result in place.

## Forms

- [Checkbox](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-checkbox--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-checkbox--overview.md)): A square that turns a choice on or off, applied when the form is saved; CheckboxGroup for any number of choices from a set.
- [Chip](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-chip--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-chip--overview.md)): A filter chip with a real checkbox or radio inside, filled with ink when on, with an optional count.
- [Combobox](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-combobox--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-combobox--overview.md)): A select you can type into: Combobox always ends on an option from the list; Autocomplete takes free text with suggestions.
- [Date picker](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-date-picker--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-date-picker--overview.md)): DatePicker for one date, typed or picked from a calendar; DateRangePicker for a period, with presets and two typed ends.
- [Field](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-field--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-field--overview.md)): A label, a control and a hint or error wired together; the page also covers Input, Textarea, SearchInput and Label.
- [File upload](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-file-upload--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-file-upload--overview.md)): A dropzone with a real Browse button, and a list of the files put there with their status and progress.
- [Form](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-form--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-form--overview.md)) (Experimental): A form that knows which fields are failing: FormErrorSummary lists them as links and takes focus on submit; Fieldset groups controls under one legend.
- [Listbox](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-listbox--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-listbox--overview.md)) (Experimental): A list of options that stays on the page, for choosing one or several without opening anything.
- [Number input](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-number-input--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-number-input--overview.md)): A number you can type and step, formatted for a locale, with bounds, a unit and steppers inside the field.
- [Radio](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-radio--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-radio--overview.md)): One choice from a small set, all visible, in a named RadioGroup; square, and told from a checkbox by its mark.
- [Segmented control](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-segmented-control--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-segmented-control--overview.md)): One choice from a few views or settings, all visible and switched instantly, cut from one piece.
- [Select](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-select--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-select--overview.md)): A choice from a list in a popup, with an optional second line per option and labelled groups.
- [Slider](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-slider--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-slider--overview.md)): A value or a range on a continuous scale, with the value always printed in tabular figures.
- [Switch](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-switch--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-switch--overview.md)): A setting that takes effect the moment it is switched; on is verde, the colour of live.
- [Tag group](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-tag-group--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-tag-group--overview.md)) (Experimental): A set of short values shown as tags, which can be removed, and selected when the set is also a choice.
- [Time picker](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-time-picker--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-time-picker--overview.md)) (Experimental): TimePicker for a time of day as hour and minute spinbuttons; DateTimePicker for a moment, a DatePicker and a TimePicker read as one Date.

## Layout

- [App shell](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-layout-app-shell--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-layout-app-shell--overview.md)): The frame a tool lives in: a top bar, a sidebar that collapses to a rail or becomes a sheet, and one scrolling main region.
- [Container](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-layout-container--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-layout-container--overview.md)): The page column, in prose, page, wide and full widths; Section and SectionHeader set the rhythm down the page.
- [Divider](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-layout-divider--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-layout-divider--overview.md)): Three dividers in rising weight and rarity: a keyline, a relleno seam and the sawtooth diente.
- [Grid](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-layout-grid--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-layout-grid--overview.md)): Column patterns that reflow; auto fits as many columns of at least minItem as there is room for.
- [Page header](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-layout-page-header--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-layout-page-header--overview.md)): The top of a page inside the shell: a breadcrumb, the title, a description, actions, a row of facts and optional tabs.
- [Panel](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-layout-panel--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-layout-panel--overview.md)): A cut surface: a region of one ground bounded by an edge, where the tone decides the ink.
- [Stack](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-layout-stack--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-layout-stack--overview.md)): Stack for a column with one gap, Inline for a row that wraps, and RowBetween for one thing at each end.
- [Toolbar](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-layout-toolbar--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-layout-toolbar--overview.md)): A row of related controls with one tab stop and arrow-key movement, with toggles, a field and an overflow menu.

## Navigation

- [Accordion](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-navigation-accordion--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-navigation-accordion--overview.md)): Sections of one document that open one or several at a time; Collapsible for a single disclosure.
- [Breadcrumb](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-navigation-breadcrumb--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-navigation-breadcrumb--overview.md)): Where a page sits, as links back up the path, with the current page as plain text.
- [Link](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-navigation-link--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-navigation-link--overview.md)) (Experimental): Going somewhere: Link for text, in a sentence or on its own, and LinkButton for a navigation cut like a button.
- [Pagination](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-navigation-pagination--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-navigation-pagination--overview.md)): Moving through a long ordered result, as numbered pages or as a compact range with two arrows.
- [Stepper](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-navigation-stepper--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-navigation-stepper--overview.md)) (Experimental): A task done in order, one step at a time: the steps with their state, and the current step as a form that validates before it moves on.
- [Tabs](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-navigation-tabs--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-navigation-tabs--overview.md)): Switching between views of one thing: underline for views, panel for tabs that are containers.
- [Tree](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-navigation-tree--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-navigation-tree--overview.md)) (Experimental): A hierarchy you move through and pick from, with branches that open and close and one selected item.

## Overlays

- [Command palette](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-overlays-command-palette--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-overlays-command-palette--overview.md)): The keyboard’s front door: a searchable list of commands and destinations, opened with ⌘K or Ctrl+K.
- [Dialog](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-overlays-dialog--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-overlays-dialog--overview.md)): Dialog for a short modal task; AlertDialog to confirm an action that destroys something.
- [Drawer](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-overlays-drawer--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-overlays-drawer--overview.md)): A panel that slides in from an edge: details beside a list, filters, or quick actions in a bottom sheet.
- [Menu](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-overlays-menu--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-overlays-menu--overview.md)): Actions on a thing that do not each deserve a button, with checkbox and radio items, submenus and shortcuts.
- [Popover](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-overlays-popover--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-overlays-popover--overview.md)): A non-modal panel anchored to the control that opened it.
- [Shortcuts dialog](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-overlays-shortcuts-dialog--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-overlays-shortcuts-dialog--overview.md)) (Experimental): Every keyboard shortcut the page binds, listed from one registry and opened with ?; useHotkeys binds and registers each one.
- [Tooltip](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-overlays-tooltip--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-overlays-tooltip--overview.md)): A short label on hover or focus, with an optional keyboard shortcut.

## Typography

- [Display](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-typography-display--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-typography-display--overview.md)): Archivo Bold set wide, for the one title that is the point of a screen.
- [Heading](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-typography-heading--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-typography-heading--overview.md)): Four heading levels for wayfinding in a tool, with size to separate the look from the outline.
- [Kbd](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-typography-kbd--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-typography-kbd--overview.md)): A key as a cut shape, with KbdChord for keys pressed together.
- [Lead](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-typography-lead--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-typography-lead--overview.md)): The paragraph under a page title that says what the screen is for, in the reading voice.
- [Meta](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-typography-meta--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-typography-meta--overview.md)): Small facts compared down a column, such as duration, cost, count and time, in tabular figures.
- [Prose](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-typography-prose--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-typography-prose--overview.md)): The reading voice for long-form markup, such as a document, a run summary or a model’s answer.
- [Pullquote](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-typography-pullquote--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-typography-pullquote--overview.md)): A voice interrupting the prose: a quotation in the reading face, under a relleno band, with its source.
- [Rotulo](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-typography-rotulo--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-typography-rotulo--overview.md)): The label register, cut short by a band, set under the block it belongs to.
- [Text](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-typography-text--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-typography-text--overview.md)): Running interface text in the system voice, in three inks: ink, ink-2 and muted.

## AI interface

- [Agent run](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-agent-run--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-agent-run--overview.md)): A long-running agent run as a timeline: its status and live clock, each step on one spine, and the reason it stopped.
- [Change review](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-change-review--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-change-review--overview.md)): A change an agent proposes, shown as the reviewer reads it, with Approve, Request changes and Reject under it.
- [Confidence](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-confidence--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-confidence--overview.md)): How sure the system is, in three levels and in words, with UncertaintyNote for a specific claim to check.
- [Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-markdown--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-markdown--overview.md)) (Experimental): A model’s Markdown answer, streamed and rendered in Mola’s typography, with its citation markers kept and no HTML ever injected.
- [Message](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-message--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-message--overview.md)): One turn of a conversation, laid out as a ledger: who spoke, when, with which model, and what they said or did.
- [Prompt input](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-prompt-input--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-prompt-input--overview.md)): The composer: a field that grows, attachments, a toolbar, and a send button that becomes Stop while a response generates.
- [Reasoning](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-reasoning--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-reasoning--overview.md)): The model’s thinking behind a disclosure, summarised as “Thought for 12.4s” and set a step quieter than the answer.
- [Run error](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-run-error--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-run-error--overview.md)): Why a run stopped: the step, a plain sentence, the error verbatim, and the ways back in order of cost.
- [Run status](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-run-status--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-run-status--overview.md)): The one status vocabulary for a run, a step and a tool call: a glyph, a word and a colour, with an elapsed clock.
- [Side-by-side diff](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-side-by-side-diff--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-side-by-side-diff--overview.md)) (Experimental): Two versions of one text in two panes, each change opposite its replacement, falling back to one column when narrow.
- [Sources](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-sources--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-sources--overview.md)): Inline citation markers and the numbered list of sources they point to, with a preview card on hover, focus or first tap.
- [Streaming text](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-streaming-text--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-streaming-text--overview.md)): A model’s answer arriving a token at a time, in the reading voice, without layout shift, and announced once when it ends.
- [Token usage](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-token-usage--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-token-usage--overview.md)): What a run consumed: input, cached and output tokens, cost, and how full the context window is.
- [Tool call](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-tool-call--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-tool-call--overview.md)): One tool invocation: the tool’s literal name, its arguments, the result or error, and an approval when a person must decide.

## Patterns

- [Agent console](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/ai-agent-console--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-agent-console--overview.md))
- [Form example](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-form-example--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-form-example--overview.md))
- [Agent hand-off](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/patterns-agent-hand-off--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/patterns-agent-hand-off--overview.md)): An agent has done what it may and stopped at what it may not: the person approves its proposed action, or takes the task over and finishes it themselves.
- [Confirmation](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/patterns-confirmation--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/patterns-confirmation--overview.md)): A destructive action that cannot be undone and takes a round trip: ask first, show it working, and say plainly whether it happened.
- [Empty states](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/patterns-empty-states--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/patterns-empty-states--overview.md)): One screen, every way a list can have nothing to show: first run, no results, loading, error and no permission, each saying something different.
- [Filtered table](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/patterns-filtered-table--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/patterns-filtered-table--overview.md)): A table of many records narrowed by several filters at once, with bulk actions on a selection and each record opening in a drawer.
- [List and detail](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/patterns-list-and-detail--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/patterns-list-and-detail--overview.md)): Every item on the start side and the chosen one on the end side, collapsing to one pane at a time when its container is narrow.
- [Settings page](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/patterns-settings-page--overview) ([Markdown](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/patterns-settings-page--overview.md)): A long settings form saved as a whole, with errors on save, a guard on leaving with unsaved changes, and a danger zone outside the form.
